title: Jelly Roll Morton recordings
summary: He made two recordings with Morton but cannot recall the songs.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: You don't remember the name of the song? You don't remember the year? Could you tell me about when you recorded with Jelly Roll Morton?
No, I can't. I got the record back there but I don't remember it.
Did you work with him for any period of time?
No. I don't write down no tune; just go ahead and play and get them over.
